source_row.rationale: Electronic hand hygiene monitoring systems can offer more continuous, objective data collection across many more interactions than manual audits, without the Hawthorne effect limitation inherent to direct observation.
source_row.source_name: CDC/Joint Commission — Hand Hygiene Monitoring Technology
